assessment: 4 continuations per legal forced first action; then V4 3-ply; shuffle hidden remainder; select snapshots with some but not all successes
controlPool: first 768 snapshots from all collection games
hardPool: failed-game first768 and 20/50/100 moves before failure, filtered by continuation trials
probabilityWarmstart: 90 CPU seconds supervised on teacher afterstates, success/failure labels; included in 450 CPU seconds; initial p=.9; supervised alpha=.1; remaining budget goal TD
updates: only stage0; five-step TD lambda=.5; 2-ply training; score alpha .02/.008/.003; probability alpha .1/.04/.015 at .5/.85 CPU fractions
handoff: score models bootstrap frozen V4 at first1536 afterstate; probability target becomes1 at1536,0 on prior death; real play switches to frozen V4 from1536 onward
selection: highest screen1536 count, then6144 count; ties control,hard,probability; freeze before inspecting holdout
holdoutPolicies: V4, control, selected candidate (reuse control when selected)
promotion: paired1536 difference lower95>0; 6144 point difference>=0 and lower95>-0.01; browser compatibility. Otherwise retain V4 default.
limits: 4 rollouts per action are a noisy recoverability filter, not proof of solvability
